dialogues.jp:
「さって、試験も終わったし、今日だけは騒ぐ
　とするか――」
dialogues.en:
"Well, now that the exams are over, I'm going to have some
fun today......!"
dialogues.text:
"Well, now that the exams are over, I'm going to have some
fun today......!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん、試験は出来ましたか？」
dialogues.en: "How were your exams, niisan?"
dialogues.text: "How were your exams, niisan?"

dialogues.jp:
音夢がにこやかにやって来て、嫌なことを｛き／訊｝い
てくる。
dialogues.en:
Nemu came over to me with a smile on her face, and asked me
something I didn't want to talk about.
dialogues.text:
Nemu came over to me with a smile on her face, and asked me
something I didn't want to talk about.

dialogues.jp:
「さぁ、どうだろう。後は講師が決めることだ
　からな」
dialogues.en:
"I don't know. I did what I could do. It's up to the
teachers now."
dialogues.text:
"I don't know. I did what I could do. It's up to the
teachers now."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「講師の方が採点する前から、結果は決まって
　いると思いますけど？」
dialogues.en:
"I think the results are already decided before the teachers
check them."
dialogues.text:
"I think the results are already decided before the teachers
check them."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「分からんぞ、もしかしたらオマケしてくれる
　かもしれな……ありえない」
dialogues.en: "Who knows? They might give me some free points...... not."
dialogues.text: "Who knows? They might give me some free points...... not."

dialogues.jp: 自分で言ってて悲しくなってきた。
dialogues.en: I felt silly for saying that.
dialogues.text: I felt silly for saying that.

dialogues.jp: 「で、お前は出来たのか？」
dialogues.en: "So how did you do?"
dialogues.text: "So how did you do?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「当然です。学業は学生の勤めですから」
dialogues.en: "Of course I did well. My work as a student is to study."
dialogues.text: "Of course I did well. My work as a student is to study."

dialogues.jp: さすが裏モード。言葉の響きが違う。
dialogues.en: That's my sister. Her outlook's always different.
dialogues.text: That's my sister. Her outlook's always different.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「これから風紀委員の活動で商店街の巡回に行
　きますけど、兄さんも寄り道などせず、まっ
　すぐ家に帰ってくださいね」
dialogues.en:
"I'm going to patrol the city now. You must go home right
away, and stay out of trouble."
dialogues.text:
"I'm going to patrol the city now. You must go home right
away, and stay out of trouble."

dialogues.jp:
凄みのある、にこやかな笑みを浮かべ、音夢が
仕事へと向かう。
dialogues.en: She smiled softly and went off to work.
dialogues.text: She smiled softly and went off to work.

dialogues.jp: 「……それは無理ってもんです」

わせわせと鞄に荷物をまとめ、帰り支度をする。
無論、行き先は家ではない。
dialogues.en:
I started packing my bag so I could leave. Of course, my
destination isn't home.
dialogues.text:
I started packing my bag so I could leave. Of course, my
destination isn't home.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「こんにちは、朝倉くん」
dialogues.en: "Hello, Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "Hello, Asakura-kun."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「え、あれ？　どうしたんです先輩？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Moe-sempai! What are you doing here?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, Moe-sempai! What are you doing here?"

dialogues.jp:
顔をあげた先に、萌先輩の微笑んだ顔があった。
付属の教室に来るなんて珍しい。
dialogues.en:
When I looked up, I saw Moe-sempai's face in front of me.
It's rare to see her in this building.
dialogues.text:
When I looked up, I saw Moe-sempai's face in front of me.
It's rare to see her in this building.

dialogues.jp: 「眞子ですか？」
dialogues.en: "Are you looking for Mako?"
dialogues.text: "Are you looking for Mako?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「今日は部活があるので、迎えに来たんです」
dialogues.en: "I came to get her because we have a club meeting."
dialogues.text: "I came to get her because we have a club meeting."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「そうか、今日で試験が終わりだから、部活が
　あるんだ」
dialogues.en:
"Oh, you have a meeting because all the exams are over
today, huh?"
dialogues.text:
"Oh, you have a meeting because all the exams are over
today, huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.jp: 試験が終わったって言うのに、大変だな……。
dialogues.en: What a bother after finally finishing all the exams......
dialogues.text: What a bother after finally finishing all the exams......

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あれ？　お姉ちゃん、何してるの？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, what are you doing here, oneechan?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, what are you doing here, oneechan?"

dialogues.jp: 鞄を持った眞子が、俺の机によってくる。
dialogues.en: Mako came close to my desk with her bag in her hand.
dialogues.text: Mako came close to my desk with her bag in her hand.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「眞子ちゃんを迎えに来たの」
dialogues.en: "I came to get you, Mako-chan."
dialogues.text: "I came to get you, Mako-chan."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「だったら声をかけてくれればいいのに」
dialogues.en: "Why didn't you talk to me then?"
dialogues.text: "Why didn't you talk to me then?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「ごめんなさい。眞子ちゃんお友達と話してた
　から、朝倉くんにご挨拶していたの」
dialogues.en:
"I'm sorry. I saw you talking with your friends, so I just
decided to say hi to Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text:
"I'm sorry. I saw you talking with your friends, so I just
decided to say hi to Asakura-kun."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「別にいいの、そんなの」
dialogues.en: "You didn't have to do that."
dialogues.text: "You didn't have to do that."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「……別にいいってのは、どっちのことだ？」
dialogues.en: "......Are you talking about you, or me?"
dialogues.text: "......Are you talking about you, or me?"

dialogues.jp:
友達と話している時に、声を掛けてもいいって
ことか、それとも俺に挨拶なんかしなくていいっ
てことか――。
dialogues.en:
Is she saying that Moe-sempai didn't have to hesitate to
talk to her, or Moe-sempai didn't have to say hi to me?
dialogues.text:
Is she saying that Moe-sempai didn't have to hesitate to
talk to her, or Moe-sempai didn't have to say hi to me?

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「両方」
dialogues.en: "Both."
dialogues.text: "Both."

dialogues.jp: 言うと思ってたよ。
dialogues.en: I thought she'd say that.
dialogues.text: I thought she'd say that.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、お姉ちゃん、行こ」
dialogues.en: "Well let's go, oneechan."
dialogues.text: "Well let's go, oneechan."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「それじゃあ、朝倉くん。私たちはお先に失礼
　しますね」
dialogues.en: "Yes...... See you later, Asakura-kun. We'll be going now."
dialogues.text: "Yes...... See you later, Asakura-kun. We'll be going now."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「ええ。部活がんばってください」
dialogues.en: "Yes. Good luck with the meeting."
dialogues.text: "Yes. Good luck with the meeting."

dialogues.jp:
微笑む萌先輩にこちらも微笑み返して、ふたり
を見送る。
dialogues.en: I smiled back at Moe-sempai, and saw them off.
dialogues.text: I smiled back at Moe-sempai, and saw them off.

dialogues.jp: 「……さて、帰って寝るか」
dialogues.en: "......Well, I should go home and take a nap."
dialogues.text: "......Well, I should go home and take a nap."

dialogues.jp: 「……じゃなくて」
廊下に出ようとしたところで教室に戻る。
dialogues.en: "......That's not it."
dialogues.text: "......That's not it."

dialogues.jp:
そして、クラスを見回し親しい友達を探しあて、
輪の中に加わった。
dialogues.en: I went back to the classroom as I tried to step out.
dialogues.text: I went back to the classroom as I tried to step out.

dialogues.jp: ◆眞子を迎えに来た◆
dialogues.en: ◆Moe-sempai came to get Mako◆
dialogues.text: ◆Moe-sempai came to get Mako◆

dialogues.jp:
テスト終了の解放感に浸っていると、音楽部の
部活に行くため、萌先輩が眞子を迎えに来た。
dialogues.en:
When I was feeling relieved that the exams were over,
Moe-sempai came into the classroom to get Mako. They're
going to a music club meeting.
dialogues.text:
When I was feeling relieved that the exams were over,
Moe-sempai came into the classroom to get Mako. They're
going to a music club meeting.

dialogues.jp:
テストが終わったばかりだというのに、大変だ
な。
dialogues.en: What a bother after finally finishing all the exams......
dialogues.text: What a bother after finally finishing all the exams......
